decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting lies far from the firm's core building and industrial knowledge, and it is only mentioned on the website, so the firm has limited related knowledge to interpret its results; still, its existing maritime experience and in-house R&D give enough of a base to keep it for another year.

The medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting and LED expertise and has its own product page, so the firm can assimilate the feedback and improve it with its in-house testing facilities.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires draw directly on the firm's certified manufacturing and industrial customer knowledge, making them easy to assimilate and develop further.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core offer, so the firm already understands its market well and can apply that learning commercially.
